newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp shares jump on new investment plan.
newsitem.headline: Sharp shares jump on new investment plan.

text.p: Shares in Sharp Corp jumped in active trade on Wednesday morning, helped by its plan to invest 90 to 100 billion yen to build a new LCD plant announced on Tuesday, traders said.
The major electronics maker's shares had risen 40 yen to 1,540 by 0050 GMT.
Trading volume was 2.050 million shares, the sixth heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Tuesday, Sharp said it expected to invest 90 to 100 billion yen in a second liquid crystal display (LCD) plant to be built at its complex in Mie prefecture, central Japan.
